question: Town A lies to the north of Town B. Town C lies to the south of Town A. Town D lies to the northeast of Town C. Town E lies to the south of Town D. Town B lies to the northwest of Town E. Town B lies to the south of Town C. What is the position of Town E with respect to Town C?
solution:
As per the given information:

Town A lies to the north of Town B.

Town C lies to the south of Town A.

Town D lies to the northeast of Town C.

Town E lies to the south of Town D.

Town B lies to the northwest of Town E.

Town B lies to the south of Town C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f9479e443bc812d86125c4f4e8497faaed33e9ef168c757672bbd52cdfa8e21.png] 

So, Southeast is the position of Town E with respect to Town C.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Southeast**".
